answer: Sybil resistance can be a signed work sonnet: each agent must publish a fixed, non-replayable sequence of epoch-bound compute receipts before it can attest. That trail hardens into a relic no clone farm can backfill after the fact, and vote weight stays locked until the identity also posts an opal bond that slashes if the same trail is reused. Mass wallets then pay twice — in cycles and in capital — before they can outvote agents who already did the work.
